places: Belgian National Day (ascension to the throne of King LEOPOLD I)

fields.climate: temperate; mild winters, cool summers; rainy, humid, cloudy
fields.terrain: flat coastal plains in northwest, central rolling hills, rugged mountains of Ardennes Forest in southeast
fields.hazards: flooding is a threat along rivers and in areas of reclaimed coastal land, protected from the sea by concrete dikes
fields.resources: construction materials, silica sand, carbonates, arable land
fields.farm: sugar beets, milk, potatoes, wheat, pork, lettuce, maize, chicken, barley, pears
fields.exports: refined petroleum, natural gas, vaccines, cars, packaged medicine
fields.industries: engineering and metal products, motor vehicle assembly, transportation equipment, scientific instruments, processed food and beverages, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, base metals, textiles, glass…
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 57.1%, Protestant 2.3%, other Christian, 2.8%, Muslim 6.8%, other 1.7%, atheist 9.1%, nonbeliever/agnostic 20.2%

system.text: federal parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy

fields.legal: civil law system based on the French Civil Code; judicial review of legislative acts
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory

holiday.name: Belgian National Day (ascension to the throne of King LEOPOLD I)

fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; maximum age varies by position; conscription abolished in 1995
